"""Fixture: names harnesses without invoking one, e.g. ``claude -p`` in prose."""

import subprocess

ENGINES = ("codex", "claude")
TOOLS = {"omniclaude": ["claude"]}
NOTE = "claude limited until tomorrow; codex free slots 2"
DOCS_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/docs"


def git_head() -> str:
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False
    ).stdout
